title: Volcanoes of Papua New Guinea (streak)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Papua New Guinea, one after another. Three markers too far from the place end the run, so aim with care. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.fact: Bam is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1954. The data places it in Papua New Guinea.
